target: Share bounded project rules, status, plans, reports, QA, and compact evidence across trusted devices.
primary_semantics: An explicit file manifest creates an immutable exact-byte generation; transport produces read-only peer evidence and never activates content.
invariants: Raw conversation history and existing archive summaries remain unchanged.
archive-v1 and environment-v1 payload contracts remain unchanged.
Every selected file is size bounded, hashed, and reconstructed without overwriting conflicts.
A macOS update switches files only after the archive reaches an idle locked boundary with no native recovery debt.
No whole-workspace scan, automatic installation, activation, or execution is permitted.
allowed_changes: Add project evidence schema, domain module, CLI, independent exchange stream, dashboard status, tests, synchronized documentation, and a quiesced macOS collector cutover.
prohibited_changes: Upload raw datasets, caches, bulk logs, or secrets.
Publish a GitHub release without separate authorization.
Mutate peer evidence or existing archive and Environment streams.
before_after_checks: Build and reconstruct exact bytes for text and CRLF evidence.
Reject conflicts and corrupt event ranges before any write.
Verify independent stream operation on macOS and Windows rehearsals.
Verify idle-boundary cutover plus previous-collector restoration on handoff and first-switch failures.
Verify rollback to v2.12.7 without changing archives.

original_triggers: A new encrypted stream must preserve independent cursors and old-reader compatibility.
Explicit structured manifests and three-language documentation must remain synchronized.
